notes:
Game modes, live Potassium control and lighter logs.

- The "change mode" screen now shows VIBIN's Potassium modes, sorted into Battle Royale, Fun and VIBIN, with their pictures. Only the modes that exist in your Fortnite version are listed.
- Chapter 3 and up: each category (Battle Royale, Zero Build, Arena, Tournament…) offers Solo / Duo / Trio / Squad in "Mode Selection".
- Chapters 1 and 2: the VIBIN modes (Custom Island, nostorm / skipbus, 1v1, Bouzi, Ether Speed Cup) then Battle Royale.
- Picking a mode in game switches the Potassium server's playlist live; "Ready" starts the server and you join the match automatically once it is joinable.
- The backend no longer writes every request to its log file (it could grow past 100 MB): only errors are kept.
- Faster mode loading.

Also in 1.3.2: builds that crashed at launch ("Ran out of memory allocating 205235675136 bytes") are fixed automatically.
